name: Shenzhen Fine Made Electronics Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Fine Made Electronics Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, packaging, testing, and sale of integrated circuits in China. The company offers power management, LED display screen and drive, PD&QC protocol, MOS, lithium battery protection, MCU, 5G RF, smart life, microwave radar, e-cigarette, and WLAN products. Its products are used in mobile terminal, big data, IoT, cloud computing, self-service and smart LED, and other fields. The company was founded in 2001 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
